title: draft-acceptance-issue
summary: Draft a campaign acceptance issue with checklist, RunSpec, evidence paths, and placeholders for baseline/candidate SHAs.

skill_metadata.name: draft-acceptance-issue
skill_metadata.description: Draft a campaign acceptance issue with checklist, RunSpec, evidence paths, and placeholders for baseline/candidate SHAs.

applicability.scope: Opening a new acceptance campaign in an RSI-style repository, before any baseline or candidate run
applicability.prerequisites: A chosen campaign subject and an empty evidence/<campaign-id>/ tree copied from evidence/_template/; SHAs may still be placeholders
applicability.input_contract: A campaign id of the form {model-or-scenario}/{device}x{count}, any user-supplied criteria or accepted plan, and available workload/baseline/calibration evidence for deriving missing targets
applicability.produced_artifact: An acceptance issue body with campaign id, pinned baseline and candidate SHAs, RunSpec, criteria source and derivation including gaps and freeze authority, gates, evidence paths, initial verdict and a downstream citation blurb
failure_modes: Gates written after the search loop has already run
Campaign SHAs committed into recipes/, benchmarks/, skills or workflow defaults
PASS claimed without a validator/ freeze and a results/ rationale
applicability.refusal_point: Refuses to state a verdict other than INCONCLUSIVE while the validator freeze or results rationale is absent

recommendations: Use user-supplied criteria; when absent, follow the performance-ceiling-analysis acceptance procedure to formulate targets, preserving partial requirements and identifying derived fields and evidence gaps.
Write the gates in plan/ before any search loop; a gate chosen afterwards cannot reject the candidate honestly.
Use the <baseline-sha> and <candidate-sha> placeholders until the campaign fixes them, and keep the real values in the issue.
Set the initial verdict to INCONCLUSIVE so the absence of evidence is recorded rather than assumed away.
limitations: Drafts an issue only; it freezes no gate and runs no measurement.
The placeholder SHA convention depends on the campaign owner filling them in later.
skill_metadata.searchspace_not_applicable: SKILL.md §§ Steps and Output prepare an acceptance issue, RunSpec, frozen gates and evidence paths; device identifiers are campaign metadata rather than a hardware-resource mechanism.
